about.intro: I help schools strengthen the Foundation Years, the years that shape everything that follows.
story: For nearly two decades I have worked in Early Childhood Education across India and the Gulf. I have designed curricula, trained educators and worked alongside school teams as they put new ideas into practice.

The question I keep coming back to is simple: why do some children thrive in school while others struggle, even when they are equally capable? The answer, I believe, begins earlier. It is in relationships, routines, language, play, emotional safety, how adults respond and what chances children get to think.

Through Educational Mentoring India I work with school owners, principals, academic leaders, coordinators and teachers to build Early Years and K-12 systems that work for real children in real classrooms, not just in documents.
I translate these ideas into practical classroom systems a teacher can use on a Monday morning with 30 children in front of her.

newsletter.name: Anubhuti
newsletter.intro: A monthly letter for families and educators. One familiar moment from a child's day, one question it raises, and one thing to try.
newsletter.letter: Hello, and welcome. Each month I will share one familiar moment from a child's day, the question it raises, and something you can try. To begin: the next time a lid, a zip or a block tower needs help, notice what the child has already tried. Offer help with one part, then give them another turn. What do they do next?

howWeWrite: Every article starts with a question from everyday life and offers something specific to try.

Illustrative moments help us think about a choice a child or an adult might make. Where something comes from a real classroom, we say so. Photographs on this site are real, and where a photo only illustrates a scene, the caption says that.

Articles point to developmental and educational sources where relevant. These are suggestions for further reading, not medical advice. If you are worried about your child's development, please talk to your paediatrician or a qualified specialist.
Foundation Years First is an initiative of Educational Mentoring India, written by Tripta Tarunesh for families and educators.
